---
title: "SupplyLens"
---

::: {.cover-box}
**Given a company name, product SKU, or barcode — SupplyLens maps the complete supply chain automatically.**
It scrapes supplier websites, extracts from procurement documents, infers hidden Tier 3–5 nodes with AI confidence scoring, and produces forensically traceable evidence for EU regulatory enforcement (CSDD, LkSG, UK Modern Slavery Act).
:::

**Research-Ready** · Industry partner: **Scania AB** · EU-hosted, self-contained, vendor-independent

---

## The Problem

Companies know their supply chain 2–3 tiers deep. Beyond that: opacity, undocumented relationships, deliberately obscured sourcing. Scania — a sophisticated manufacturer — has no reliable picture of who supplies their suppliers' suppliers.

This blindness has direct regulatory consequence. EU CSDD (Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive), LkSG, and the UK Modern Slavery Act require companies to demonstrate visibility and remediation. Without tooling, compliance is a document exercise, not a verifiable fact.

**SupplyLens makes supply chain visibility reproducible, traceable, and enforceable.**

---

## What It Produces

| Output | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Supply chain graph** | Neo4j knowledge graph: Tier 1–5 suppliers, raw materials, certifications, logistics hubs, risk events |
| **Confidence-scored inferences** | LLM-inferred Tier 3–5 links with source attribution and confidence 0–1 |
| **Risk flags** | `SINGLE_SOURCE`, `GEOPOLITICAL_RISK`, `LABOR_VIOLATION`, `SANCTIONS_HIT` per node |
| **EDRM evidence chain** | Every node carries: scraped source, extraction method, RAG citation, timestamp |
| **Supplier scorecards** | Printable A4 PDFs per supplier: risk ring, compliance matrix, financials, evidence |
| **Regulatory report** | EDRM-compliant enforcement filing showing suppressed alternatives and known violations |

---

## Demo: Scania AB

Input: `company = "Scania AB"`, `depth = 3`

```
Scania R-series Truck
  └─► Scania AB (SE)
        ├─► ZF Friedrichshafen (DE) — Tier 1  ⚠ SINGLE_SOURCE
        │     └─► Saarstahl AG (DE) — Tier 2
        ├─► Bosch (DE) — Tier 1
        │     ├─► Infineon Technologies (DE) — Tier 2
        │     └─► Sensata Technologies (NL) — Tier 2
        ├─► SSAB (SE) — Tier 1
        │     └─► LKAB (SE) — Tier 2  (iron ore)
        └─► Dana Incorporated (US) — Tier 1  ⚠ SINGLE_SOURCE
```

Current graph: **251 nodes** — 111 suppliers, 48 raw materials, 23 events, 15 certifications, 10 products across 20+ countries.

## Stack

All components self-hosted. No SaaS dependencies. Runs on local Docker Compose or a Proxmox cluster.

| Component | Role |
|-----------|------|
| **Neo4j** | Supply chain knowledge graph |
| **LangGraph** | Multi-step enrichment agent (scrape → extract → infer → merge) |
| **LiteLLM + Ollama** | LLM inference, local models (qwen3:8b) |
| **Qdrant** | Semantic search over supplier documents |
| **n8n** | Scheduled weekly refresh |
| **Browserless** | JS-rendered supplier website scraping |
